full_page.content:
Page 72 Cont.
Sept. 5th Leone Maurice Christians - 49 - cancer of liver - had operation July Ist - better but slow
Louis Czerwinski - 63 - throat cancer. ...
Jane Tait - 45 - Nerveous - break.
Mrs. Anna Oss - 54 - leg-ulcers
Marjorie Leechman - 15 - just starting high-school. Mother frantic at husband's insisting on public high instead of Catholic. Cath. father - He ought to remember the censure.
Mrs. Anna Scheiber - about 45 - presbiterian - something very much cancer like of the face .... improving since enrolled 3 weeks ago
Page 73 Mrs. Madeline Bray - 45 - ailing for seven years - with toomers. Enrolled August 24th and prayed for - greatly improving .... Deo Gratias
Sept. 7 Hugh Stewart enrolled for grace to go back to go back to sacraments. Deo Gr. he did go back before death last November.
Sept. 7th Lawrence Harvey - 40 - Vanished Aug. 23 - on way to work with car. Believed to have been waylaid, has not been seen since now two weeks.
Robert Piscopink - 5 - a twin - leakage of heart - in bed now three months - his twin sister started to school - bright child.
8 Louis Laboe - 46 - fractured scull - brok-back in auto accident Feb. 9th - is able to be around in harness - but asks for prayers for im- provement. Helpt in - four men helped him in. Oct. 14th here To-day a "new-man" perfectly healthy - working since Sept. 21st.
Page 74 Sept. 8th Aliqua - about 40+ - phones first and then is silent - Finally tells of fearful temptation "to end all.
10th Baby Mary Shriner four days old - a bleeder - Enrolled To-day as against further loss of blood .... Parents have lost three little ones so far and now as pray
